# PR #5023 generator snapshot

This is the unchanged script and input snapshot from PR #5023, head
`ea84284764cc7ac0bc22c58f15d3c5c0c8f6ba0b`. It is retained as provenance,
not as a verified deterministic reproduction recipe.

Do not run this script in the working corpus: its original output paths point
to `captures/generated-local/` and would overwrite earlier files. Reproduction
must use an isolated export. No generator or loopback service was started when
these files were merged.

The retained output is instead versioned in `captures/generated-pr5023/`.
Its original declared recipe hash was `eba6701547c2059f7bfe4b060dcf8ae4be83aa1e`,
but the committed script hashes to `eae1024408132ac83ca5b6436dcd6ac850a3e8d6`.
Both values are recorded in `reports/PR_MERGE_AUDIT.json`; matching the script
to every captured output remains pending. A display-filter match alone does
not establish a valid complete message or application parser support.
